# Engineering Standard

## Purpose

Define organization-wide engineering expectations without embedding technology-specific implementation detail.

## Scope

- Applies to all engineering work routed through GHCP.
- Covers shared expectations for design, implementation, review, and delivery.
- Remains technology-neutral unless a separate standard adds domain context.

## Ownership

- Primary owner: engineering platform maintainers.
- Reviewers: capability owners, profile owners, and repository maintainers.

## Review Process

- Review proposed changes for clarity, scope, and reuse.
- Confirm the standard stays concise and organizationally relevant.
- Avoid duplicating module, profile, or skill guidance.

## Future Content

- Engineering decision principles.
- Code review expectations.
- Delivery quality expectations.
- Change management expectations.
